name: monday
description: Work with monday.com boards, items, and updates via its GraphQL API using the user's own token. Load for board/item reads, creating items, and posting updates.

content.inline:
## monday.com
monday is a single GraphQL endpoint. Calls go through `v/ops/http/post` to `https://api.monday.com/v2` with `secretHeaders: {"Authorization": "s/MONDAY_TOKEN"}` (a personal API token: your avatar -> Developers -> My access tokens; sent as the raw `Authorization` value). Send body `{"query": "<graphql>"}` and read `data`; never put the token in the request.

Common calls (POST `{query}`):
- Whoami: `{ me { id name email } }`
- Your boards: `{ boards(limit: 50) { id name state } }`
- Items on a board: `{ boards(ids: [BOARD_ID]) { items_page(limit: 100) { cursor items { id name column_values { id text } } } } }`
- Create an item: `mutation { create_item(board_id: BOARD_ID, item_name: "NAME") { id } }`
- Post an update: `mutation { create_update(item_id: ITEM_ID, body: "TEXT") { id } }`

Rules:
- Check `status` and the JSON: GraphQL errors return `{errors: [{message}]}` even on HTTP 200 (`Not Authenticated` = bad token).
- Numeric ids are unquoted in GraphQL; strings are quoted. Escape quotes inside the query string.
- Page a board with `items_page.cursor`, passed back via `next_items_page`.
